summary_en: Tender-offer period extended from 13 July to 28 July 2026 (40 business days). Offeror: Nice Corporation. Tender price: ¥601/share. Minimum acceptance: 402,600 shares. Objective: complete take-private. Board recommendation reaffirmed.
title_en: Notice of Partial Revision – Endorsement of Opinion and Recommendation to Tender in Nice Corporation Public Tender Offer for Yamadai Corporation Shares
translation_en_brief: This disclosure announces a revision to Yamadai Corporation's earlier endorsement and recommendation notice concerning a public tender offer by Nice Corporation. The primary change is an extension of the tender-offer period from 13 July 2026 to 28 July 2026 (increasing the window from 30 to 40 business days). The tender price remains ¥601 per ordinary share, the minimum acceptance threshold is 402,600 shares (no upper limit stated), and the stated objective is to make Yamadai a wholly owned subsidiary of Nice. The company's board of directors, by resolution on the date of this notice, reaffirmed its endorsement of the offer and reiterated its recommendation that shareholders tender their shares. All independent directors approved and all independent statutory auditors raised no objection to this decision. The extension was initiated by the offeror and is disclosed in an accompanying notice from Nice Corporation.
